note: Pixel measurements on references/rolex-day-date-40-228235/rolex-228235_original.png (native 1920 x 2857 RGBA, upright studio render, no working copy). pivot = hub screw (960, 1424), hub disc radius 17 px. Scale: the 40 mm case = the fluted bezel's flank at the pivot row: alpha edge x 511.6 (alpha 89 of 255 at pixel 511) and the case centre x 960.0 (min / max+1 of all alpha rows outside the lugs and the crown give 960.0) -> 40 mm = 2 x (960 - 511.6) = 896.8 px, 22.42 px/mm (cross-checks: lug to lug rows 908.5..1982.5 = 47.9 mm; bracelet at the lugs 472..478 px = 21.1 mm like the other Rolex renders). rings (radii in px about the ring centre (959.1, 1424.4), circle fits on 1-deg rays): rehaut bright outer edge 352 (pink band to 362 is the bezel's inner bevel), grey polished flange 363..376.2 (flange_out = where the grey ends, rms 0.8 px over 199 rays), then the brown chamfer to the flutes' inner zig-zag and the FLUTED bezel: 76 flutes = 152 facets of 2.368 deg (boundary spacing from 87 edge peaks, resultant 0.957 at N = 152; a boundary sits exactly at 12 / 3 / 6 / 9 o'clock), boundaries alternate LONG (even index counted ccw from 12 o'clock: includes 9 and 12 o'clock) and SHORT: LONG inner end r 384.5 / outer end r 439.4, SHORT inner r 389.5 / outer r 436.1 (alternating ray measurements at +0.35 facet from each boundary, solved for the two parities); outside the facets a smooth case flank band to r 447.5 (the silhouette). dial edge r 339.5 (minute-track circle). hands (about 10:09:30 like every Rolex render): hour 305.5 deg, minute 63.55 deg, seconds 186.3 deg; the gold baton hands (bright face, dark facet and a thin bright rim line) are NOT separable from the chocolate dial by a threshold, so each is a polygon (s along the hand from the pivot, w perpendicular, clockwise side +) from edge scans at 7-9 positions along each hand: hour tail end s -58.3, tip 193.3, w -17 .. +12 at s 60 tapering to -14.6 .. +8.1; minute tail -58.3, tip 312.3, w -14.3 .. +15 (tail +17.3) tapering to -11.5 .. +9.2; seconds needle tail -100, tip 317, w -6.5 .. +8 tapering to -3.6 .. +3.2 (no lume dot, hollow counterweight tail). Cyclops: lens outline traced on a 5x crop (flat top y 1355.6, flat bottom y 1486, bowed sides, widest x 1110 / 1276), +-1 px. Day window (arc at 12), date numeral, Roman numerals / indices, coronet, print: texture. crown box x 1406..1467 (dark guard edge from x 1406, flutes to x 1450, cap to 1467), y 1367.5..1506.5 (centre y 1437 = 0.58 mm below the pivot, radius 69.5 px = 3.1 mm, 1 px inside the photo outline so no grey map fill shows as a halo; first pass 1410 / 1369..1505 was 2 px too small against the render overlay); crown rows 1366..1508 take the left flank mirrored about the case centre (no guards). tip rows: lug top y 908.5 (slanted edge 909..913) and lug bottom y 1982.5. The photo has no drop shadow (one alpha component).
